atoms.name: Multipliers
atoms.one_line: $l_{ij}=$ entry over pivot; $L$ stores the multipliers.

atoms.name: Determinant
atoms.one_line: $\det A=\prod u_{ii}$ since $L$ has unit diagonal.

atoms.name: Zero pivot and pivoting
atoms.one_line: A zero pivot needs a row swap: $PA=LU$.

atoms.name: Cost
atoms.one_line: Factor once at $O(n^3)$, each new $b$ costs $O(n^2)$.
